$comment: Copy to .devbook/config.local.json — gitignored, yours, never committed. It merges over .devbook/config.json: objects key by key with this file winning, arrays replaced whole, and `gates` appended so an overlay can add a checkpoint and has no way of spelling the removal of one. `null` here means deliberately unbound, never delete. Four things it may not say: `components` (a stamp is repo-scope), `policy.pr.required`, `policy.qa.ceiling`, and `policy.gate.personalValidation` — those describe what this repository produces rather than how your machine runs it. Everything else in bindings, extensions, and policy is yours to adjust. Validate with tools/stack-config/check.mjs, which finds this file beside the committed one. Still no model and still no secret: gitignored is not private.

gates.prompt: This one runs long on my machine. Go ahead?
